channels.question: Where is this service available?
channels.hint: Choose the channels you actually use and note roughly when each one launched.
channels.sectionTitle: Where this service can be found
channels.sectionDescription: Keep the channel and launch date so Bee can compare what each source actually brings.
channels.empty: No launch channel has been recorded yet.
channels.discoveryQuestion: Where did this customer first find you?
channels.transactionQuestion: Where did the purchase or payment happen?
channels.transactionHint: Use the same channel if discovery and purchase happened in one place.

evidenceActions.deleteDescription: The original record and Bee's extracted details will be removed. Other facts and the case will stay intact.

hero.titleLine1: What matters is not a single service.
hero.titleLine2: It is the experience it leaves behind.
hero.description: Bee will remember it for you.
hero.method: Keep the facts of real work. Let repeated signals become a method of your own.

insight.sampleTitle: Bee forms a point of view from your services, cases and real records.
insight.realTitle: Your real work is beginning to leave a trace.
insight.realEmphasis: Keep moving and the signal will become clearer.

memory.title: Your experience stays here
memory.emptyDescription: Leave the facts first. Observations will emerge on their own.
memory.observationState: Bee is organizing the facts you left
memory.observationDescription: {evidence} facts are now part of your business memory. Repeated signals will emerge as real experience grows.
memory.patternState: Some signals are beginning to repeat
memory.patternDescription: Bee has found {patterns, plural, one {one repeating signal} other {# repeating signals}} in your real records.

loop.title: How experience becomes a method
loop.description: Keep what happened first. Let repeated signals reveal themselves over time.

principle.title: Principle
principle.description: Distill a method of your own.

workspace.title: Return from judgment to real work.
workspace.description: Services, cases, records and reflection keep growing here.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.description: Bee remembers the signals that repeat in real work. One observation is not a conclusion; only experiments and validation can turn it into a principle that is truly yours.
reflection.emptyTitle: Bee does not have enough evidence for an {stage} yet.
reflection.emptyDescription: Complete one real service and leave behind a case and its records. Only repeated signals are worth keeping.
reflection.activeEyebrow: A signal is beginning to repeat
reflection.activeDescription: Bee will keep comparing similar cases and resist conclusions until the evidence is strong enough.

login.title: Return to Be Water
login.description: Enter your email and we will send you a secure sign-in link. You will return to the place you were about to continue.
login.success: Your sign-in link is on its way. Check your inbox.
login.error: We could not send the link. Please try again shortly.

today.title: What happened today?
today.description: Keep the facts before trying to summarize them. A way of working often begins with an ordinary note.

service.title: Record a service from today
service.description: What you delivered, how long it took and what changed.

case.title: Add a case
case.description: Keep the customer, service and result in one real story.

feedback.title: Add customer feedback
feedback.description: A sentence, a repeat purchase or the reason a deal did not happen.

today.placeholder: Do not polish it. Start with facts, numbers, a conversation or how it felt…
today.saved: It is here. One day it may become a signal.

services.title: What services do you mainly offer?
services.description: No product description needed. We’ll take it one step at a time.

0.question: Which service do you mainly offer?
0.hint: Choose the closest one or write your own.

1.question: How do you usually charge for it?
1.hint: Choose the way you use most often.

2.question: What is the average price?
2.hint: Keep a price you have actually used.

3.question: How much of your time does it take?
3.hint: Count only the time you spend delivering the work.

4.question: How long does delivery usually take?

5.question: What stages does this service usually go through?
5.hint: This is the story line for every real engagement. Reorder, remove or add stages of your own.

stages.description: Keep only the stages that really happen. Every new case will begin with this story line.

menu.label: More actions
menu.deleteConfirm: “{name}” and every case it holds will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

services.emptyTitle: Bee does not know what you sell yet.
services.emptyDescription: Build the first service from real numbers: pricing, price, effort and delivery time.

service.legacyDescription: Pricing and time have not been added yet
service.recentSummary: In the last 30 days, you kept {count} real engagements here.
service.whoHint: A name or a label you will recognize is enough.
service.whenHint: Keep the date. There is no need to summarize yet.
service.customerPlaceholder: What should you call them? A name you will recognize later is enough.
service.caseHasFacts: This experience is beginning to stay
service.deleteCaseDescription: This experience with “{name}”, all of its original facts and Bee's organized results will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
service.emptyTitle: Just finished working with a customer?
service.emptyDescription: Start with who and when. The conversation, quote, delivery and feedback can follow.
service.notFound: This service could not be found.

stages.title: Each engagement usually moves through these stages
stages.description: New cases inherit this Timeline. Work that already happened will not be rewritten.
stages.editorHint: Drag to reorder, remove what does not happen, or add a stage from your real work.

case.journeyTitle: How far did this service go?
case.journeyDescription: Open any step and keep the facts. Bee will make sense of them.

stageHints.conversation: Paste a full conversation or attach the original screenshot
stageHints.quote: Keep the price you actually gave
stageHints.delivery: Keep the timing or completion fact
stageHints.note: Keep what really happened at this stage

conversation.question: What happened in the first conversation?
conversation.hint: Paste the whole conversation. Do not trim it or summarize it for Bee first. A screenshot can remain as a raw attachment too.
conversation.placeholder:
Customer: Hi, I would like to know more…

You: Hi…

Customer: My budget is around…

quote.question: What price did you quote?
quote.hint: Keep the real number. Do not judge it yet.
quote.placeholder: Add the customer's response if useful (optional)

delivery.question: What happened at delivery?
delivery.hint: Keep the timing, completion or one change.
delivery.placeholder: For example: delivered one day later than planned…

feedback.question: What did the customer say afterward?
feedback.hint: Their own words are best. One sentence is enough.
feedback.placeholder: For example: Thank you, I finally know what to do next.

note.question: What other fact should remain?
note.hint: Do not explain it yet. Just keep it.
note.placeholder: A fact, number or a full raw conversation…

case.notFound: This case could not be found.

notebook.title: Business Notebook
notebook.description: Bee organizes signals that repeat in real work. You do not have to write the conclusion here.
notebook.beeRule: Once is a fact. Repetition may become a pattern.
notebook.observationTitle: Across {cases} case records, Bee has kept {evidence} pieces of real evidence.
notebook.observationBody: They belong to {services} service records. Bee will keep looking for what they share.
notebook.patternBody: This kind of evidence has appeared {count} times. It is worth watching, but it is not a conclusion yet.
notebook.pendingTitle: Evidence is gathering. A pattern has not formed.
notebook.pendingBody: Bee will not turn one experience into a conclusion.
notebook.principleBody: Only after a pattern survives across different cases can it become a way of working that is truly yours.
notebook.emptyTitle: Bee does not have enough evidence for an observation yet.
notebook.emptyDescription: Build one real service, then leave cases and evidence behind. Only repeated signals are worth keeping.
notebook.analysisLoading: Bringing the full business context together
notebook.analysisLoadingBody: Service baselines, launch channels, customer sources, repeat purchases, case stages and raw facts all inform this observation.
notebook.analysisFailed: This observation is not ready yet
notebook.analysisFailedBody: Your original facts are still intact. Bee will try again the next time you return.

diagnosis.title: Begin with what has actually happened.
diagnosis.description: You do not need polished answers. Bee looks across your ability, what people need and the evidence you already have to find the first path worth testing.

ability.title: What do people most often ask you for help with?
ability.hint: Name something you have done repeatedly and that others already trust you to do.
ability.placeholder: For example: helping founders clarify how they talk about their brand…

outcome.title: What usually changes because of your work?
outcome.hint: Describe the result the other person truly receives when the work is done.
outcome.placeholder: For example: a complex value proposition becomes clear and easy to understand…

evidence.title: What real experience suggests this is true?
evidence.hint: A client, a project or a piece of feedback is enough to begin.
evidence.placeholder: For example: in my most recent project, the client…

diagnosis.saving: Forming your first point of view…
